'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike d'Amboise LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike d'Amboise]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Echo Base Operations|Hoth-L-echobaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
